adjudication.family_description: A Finnish Oy pays a domestic supplier bill; the payer pays the ALV-inclusive total, the net-of-ALV amount with no explanation, or the bill itself is reverse-charged at 0 %.
adjudication.error_mode: tax/evidence ambiguity: a net payment against a VAT-inclusive bill is a treatment question, a reverse-charge bill paid net is exact
adjudication.label_reason: The transfer carries the viite but equals exactly the net-of-ALV amount (1 000,00 € of 1 255,00 €) with no advice: the task is payment allocation, and the corpus convention (dev-001b, holdout-028b) allocates what arrived by reference and reports the remainder; whether the 255,00 € is a short payment, a disputed ALV line or a reverse-charge treatment the bill should have carried is remaining work outside this contract.
adjudication.terminal_reason: Relabelled after review (2026-09-18): the earlier NEEDS_REASONING label prohibited a partial allocation the contract accepts everywhere else; the tax question concerns the remainder, not the allocation of the evidenced 1 000,00 €.
